locator.title: Топ-6 аттракционов в «Острове Мечты» для фаната экстрима

nearest_text_before.text: Звуковые и световые эффекты битвы черепашек со злодеями создадут ощущение полного погружения в мультфильм и принесут еще больше эмоций и адреналина.

nearest_text_after.text: Если горок оказалось недостаточно или хочется пощекотать свои нервы, загляните на иммерсивное шоу «По ту сторону цирка».

image_reading: A green roller-coaster train full of riders is caught high on a steep, curved track inside a dark indoor city-street set.
The train, heavy steel supports, faux buildings, street signs, and blue overhead lights create a dramatic sense of height, speed, and disorientation.
analysis.article_context: Body image for the article’s #1 attraction, “Flight in the Tunnel”: it should convey the breath-catching speed and sharp turns of a New York subway-themed roller coaster.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: The animation supports the article’s top-ranked extreme ride by making its high-speed, disorienting turn feel immediate.
structured_intent.primary_action: The roller-coaster train continues racing through the curved track.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The train is visibly farther along at the upper right-hand portion of the curved track, still moving.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The ride remains an intense, high-speed indoor coaster experience throughout.

models.scene_plan: Across five seconds, the train immediately advances through the visible steep curve in one sustained, fast but readable sweep. Keep the camera fixed on the track and train so the riders and curved rail remain legible; the motion carries it toward the upper right-hand portion of the curve, where it is still visibly in motion in the final frames.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera on the roller-coaster train as it surges along the steep curved track, riders leaning with the turn; it reaches the higher right-hand curve by the final frame, still racing through the dark indoor city.

models.scene_plan: For this five-second version, begin the continuous train movement at once and let it travel a substantial distance through the existing banked track. A fixed viewpoint preserves the scale of the supports and street set. The train progresses smoothly toward the upper-right curve and arrives there close to the ending without stopping or introducing another event.
models.positive_prompt: The roller-coaster train drives through the steep curve in a sustained rush, riders leaning into the turn. Fixed view; by the last frame the train has climbed into the upper right-hand curve and continues forward at speed.

models.scene_plan: In four seconds, focus on one compact but continuous burst of train travel through the visible curve. Hold a fixed camera on the train as the focal subject, allowing the riders’ lean to reinforce the turn. It advances to the upper-right section of track by the final moment, retaining the ride’s high-speed intensity.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera: the roller-coaster train races through the steep banked curve, with riders leaning in the same direction. It reaches the upper right-hand section of track in the final frame, still moving fast.
